title: NASA astronaut Christina Koch to appear at Philadelphia Eagles game
excerpt: The Artemis II mission specialist will engage with fans at the stadium on October 4, 2026.
bodyHtml:
NASA announced that astronaut Christina Koch will attend the Philadelphia Eagles versus Los Angeles Rams game in Philadelphia on October 4, 2026. The appearance is part of the agency's Inspiration Tour, which connects NASA with stakeholders in the academic, industry, and public sectors.

NASA team members will host an Experience Zone outside the stadium from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. before the game. The event will feature interactive games and information regarding the Artemis program, which is the agency's effort to return to the Moon.

The Inspiration Tour will conclude with a public exposition titled MAX POWER, scheduled for November 7 and November 8, 2026, near the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
